description: This file declares functions related to ingress bandwidth control for the RTL8367C switch chip. It contains include guards, includes another driver header, and declares external functions for setting and getting ingress bandwidth parameters, as well as bypass configurations.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIngressBandwidth
methods.description: Sets the ingress bandwidth for a specific port along with pre-IFG and flow control enablement.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIngressBandwidth
methods.description: Retrieves the ingress bandwidth, pre-IFG, and flow control enablement status for a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIngressBandwidthBypass
methods.description: Enables or disables bypass mode for ingress bandwidth control.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIngressBandwidthBypass
methods.description: Checks if ingress bandwidth bypass mode is enabled.
